title: How do i make sure its not a scam.

posts.author: samrad
posts.body: Hello.I really wanted rpg maker 2003 but I live in iran where steam is restricted. There's a website that promises to be like steam and rpg maker 2003 is buy able from there. How do I make sure it's not just a pirated version? The website doesn't seem sketchy and Google says it's safe. But I want to make sure it's not a scam.

posts.author: ZombieKidzRule
posts.body:
Can’t you buy it from Komodo Plaza directly instead of Steam?
The Home page here allows you to see products and buy the different versions.

posts.author: TRIDIUM
posts.body:
RPG Maker 2003
For the First Time Ever, RPG Maker 2003 is Officially Available in English! This legendary game development engine is both highly affordable and easy to use, and it remains one of the most popular RPG Maker instalments to date. It is the first engine in the series to employ a sideview battle...
plaza-us.komodo.jp
As Zombie said, you'd best just get it here. It's on sale for 2 bucks right now too.

posts.author: samrad
posts.body: I got it and it was good. Thanks!

posts.author: Ms Littlefish
posts.body: Honestly, for any multitude of products and services…I’m wary of anything that does not come from an official retailer. Getting it from KOMODO Plaza was the right call.
